paragraphs: Prodata PTexcellence provides AFC platforms, EMV/contactless payment equipment, ITS, and passenger information systems for public transport. The company positions itself as one supplier across the full transport stack, with validators in the field and an AFC platform in the backend. Delivery is described as hardware plus software in a modular approach, with integration through open APIs and standards.

PROXIMA connects validators, fare rules, payments, customer accounts, and reporting in one multi-tenant AFC platform. Field hardware covers on-board validators, gate validators, NFC/EMV readers, and secure field hardware designed for continuous transport operation. The software layer covers integrated transport systems, fleet telemetry, real-time predictions, passenger communication, displays, and operator monitoring.

The pages name public transport operators, authorities, infrastructure partners and smart cities as the buyers addressed. Listed project types run from validator rollouts to full AFC modernization. Specific certifications, deployment counts, and SLA terms are stated to be confirmed per project during scoping.

quote.text: Engineered for transport systems that must last.
